name: Agate
description: Agate is a server for the Gemini network protocol, built with the Rust programming language. Agate has very few features, and can only serve static files. It uses async I/O, and should be quite efficient even when running on low-end hardware and serving many concurrent requests.

paths.name: Data directory
paths.description: Your gemini content. This directory should contain your .gmi files, but must contain one directory for each hostname if you specify more than one hostname.

paths.name: Certificates
paths.description: The certificates for your gemini capsules. A `/cert.der` and `/key.der` for each hostname. These will be generated automatically if not present.

ports.name: Gemini
ports.description: The port to serve on. Gemini clients expect this to be 1965 when unspecified.
